g.title: cluster_runtime
g.text: 2 Research workflow | one bounded LangGraph agent

g.title: RIGHTS
g.text: MOM / MTI reports and extracted text
stay local; links and metadata in Git

g.title: SCAN
g.text: Quality flags, not a proof of safety

g.title: CHUNK
g.text: Same source / section; passage IDs retained

g.title: MCP
g.text: Schema checks, deadlines, size caps, quarantine

g.title: WEBONLY
g.text: Rewrite / triage errors pass to agent

g.title: PLAN
g.text: Choose from typed read-only tools (three evaluated, four served)

g.title: SEARCH
g.text: In process in live / full evaluation

g.title: ISOLATE
g.text: Evidence registry separate from planner state

g.title: ASSESS
g.text: 2 rounds / 6 tool calls; 10 s per tool

g.title: AUDIT
g.text: Private files, not public report text

g.title: ENTRY
g.text: All three tools direct, not MCP

g.title: HARNESS
g.text: Raw run artefacts retained; no live feedback

g.title: THREAT
g.text: Secrets / unsafe tools / MCP hostile fixtures

g.title: LEGEND
g.text: Blue cylinders: local evidence / audit stores
Dashed links: alternate entry / read route
